reason: This plugin is primarily a planning workflow integration for DSH users: it hooks the plan-review phase to open Plannotator and keeps plan decisions (approve/deny/dismiss) in sync, with additional commands for review and annotation. Evidence shows it is also a terminal-integrated tool bridge that launches a local Plannotator binary via configurable paths, so risk is moderate due local command execution.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 dsh 的计划模式下调用本地 Plannotator 应用进行计划审核，并提供计划复核、标注与最近回复等命令入口。
summaries.en: This plugin connects DSH plan mode to Plannotator for plan review, adding commands to review plans, annotate items, and work with the latest assistant reply.

capabilities: launches and interacts with the Plannotator plan-review workflow
adds slash commands for review, annotate, and last-reply actions
depends on and invokes a local `plannotator` CLI process

reasons.code: plan-mode review flow is redirected from native DSH UI to Plannotator
plugin defines CLI-driven commands that call `plannotator review/annotate/last`
plugin is distributed as a DSH bundle with Cordis patch wiring
